vectors.name: register_descriptor_request_bip380
vectors.description: Register Descriptor request for the alias "main" carrying a FORM 0x01 descriptor, the BIP-380 text wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*).

vectors.name: register_descriptor_request_bip388
vectors.description: Register Descriptor request for the alias "main" carrying a FORM 0x02 wallet policy: two keys, [00000000/48h/1h/0h/2h]xpub and [11111111/48h/1h/0h/2h]xpub, and the policy wsh(sortedmulti(2,@0/**,@1/**)).

vectors.name: register_descriptor_request_status_query
vectors.description: Register Descriptor request with no descriptor, so DESCRIPTOR has PRESENCE 0x00. It only asks whether the alias "main" is registered.

vectors.name: register_descriptor_response_registered
vectors.description: Register Descriptor ok response echoing the alias "main", REGISTERED present and true, STORED present and true, and a POR of 8 bytes of 0xaa. The device both persisted the descriptor and issued a proof.

vectors.name: register_descriptor_response_not_registered
vectors.description: Register Descriptor ok response to a status query: alias "main", REGISTERED present and false, STORED absent (the device does not report whether it stored the descriptor, so the wallet must assume it did not), no POR.
